description: Search the Vybe Marketplace for MCP tools the user can use: free tools (run with run_free_tool, no sign-in) and paid tools (pay per use with pay_offering). Use this when the user asks for a capability you do not have, e.g. reading a PDF, looking up a postcode or checking a crypto transaction. Returns name, one-line summary, price, actions and offeringUrl. Never invent tools; if nothing fits, say so. Related: get_tool, pay_offering.

inputSchema.description: All fields optional. With no query, returns the most used tools.

access.description: Optional: only free or only paid tools. Defaults to all.

query.description: Plain words for what the user needs, e.g. 'pdf to text' or 'uk postcode'.

inputSchema.title: SearchToolsInput

name: search_tools

tools.description: slug, name, summary, category, access, price, actions, seller, health, url, and offeringUrl (paid) or mcpUrl (free).

title: Search marketplace tools
